title: Data Analysis — Measurement Model Testing (CFA)
text:
Database & Respondent Processing
Respondent data is automatically pulled from Google Sheets (Scoring). Subsequently, the data is checked and filtered according to predetermined criteria to obtain data that is ready to use.
Last updated: 05 September 2026, Pukul 00:11 WIB
Below is the data filtering process from incoming respondents to the final data.
After the filtering process is complete, a total of 677 observations are obtained which can be used for further analysis.

title: Summary & Conclusions
text:
Model Fit Summary (CFA)
Below is a summary of all analysis results, including CFA Model Fit and Reliability (Alpha, Omega, and AVE) for all measurement variables.
Show code
df_cfa <- rbind(
  if(!is.null(fit_eid)) get_cfa_fit_df(fit_eid, "EID") else NULL,
  if(!is.null(fit_esi)) get_cfa_fit_df(fit_esi, "ESI") else NULL,
  if(!is.null(fit_psmls)) get_cfa_fit_df(fit_psmls, "PSMLS") else NULL,
  if(!is.null(fit_peb)) get_cfa_fit_df(fit_peb, "PEB") else NULL,
  if(!is.null(fit_pwb)) get_cfa_fit_df(fit_pwb, "PWB") else NULL
)

if (!is.null(df_cfa) && nrow(df_cfa) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(df_cfa)
} else {
  cat("No CFA model data available to summarize.\n")
}
